mapper.insert: insert into sai_model_config (provider_id, model_name, model_key, model_type, adapter_key, description, api_endpoint, scope, is_default, is_enabled, created_dt, updated_dt) values (#{providerId}, #{modelName}, #{modelKey}, #{modelType}, #{adapterKey}, #{description}, #{apiEndpoint}, #{scope}, #{isDefault}, #{isEnabled}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from sai_model_config where model_key = #{modelKey}
select count(1) from sai_model_provider where id = #{providerId}
select id as provider_id, provider_name as provider_name, provider_key as provider_key from sai_model_provider where is_enabled = 1 order by id asc
